title: The Two Sneaky Numbers of Digitville
summary: In Digitville, there is a list of numbers ranging from 0 to n-1, with each number intended to appear exactly once.
statement: In Digitville, there is a list of numbers ranging from 0 to n-1, with each number intended to appear exactly once. However, two numbers have appeared an extra time, making the list longer than it should be. Your task is to identify these two extra numbers and return them in an array, so that order is restored in Digitville.
constraints: nums contains every value from 0 through n-1 once, except two distinct values appear twice.
Return the two repeated values in increasing order.
Do not rely on the duplicates being adjacent.
hints: A value belongs in the answer exactly when it is seen a second time.
Sort the two collected duplicates before returning.
The input multiplicity guarantee makes each duplicate appear exactly once in the collected result.
editorial: The input multiplicity guarantee makes each duplicate appear exactly once in the collected result.

tests.explanation: Zero and one are the two values that occur twice.
Two and three are repeated among otherwise unique values.
